post.instagram_caption:
FTX customers got back 119%. So why does it feel like a loss?

In November 2022, over $8 billion of FTX customers' money was gone, per US prosecutors. Founder Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted and sentenced to 25 years in March 2024. Then the bankruptcy plan, approved in October 2024, gave 98% of creditors 119% of their claim. The catch: claims were priced in dollars on the day FTX went bankrupt, when 1 Bitcoin was $16,871. 119% of that is about $20,076. On Nov 18, 2026, 1 Bitcoin was about $62,541. In Bitcoin terms, that's about 32%.

Would you rather be paid back in dollars or in coins?
